note: Option ids are not stored here on purpose: they change every time the column list is replaced. scripts/board.sh looks them up by name at call time.
shape: One human column. Bob's Draft Notes is where work starts and /factory-needs-you is where it comes back; everything between them moves itself. Each of those columns is named after the command or app that acts on it, so a command with no column is one nothing runs. A card parked in /factory-needs-you carries a bold ACTION line and a RETURN TO line at the top of its body, naming what it wants and which column it goes back to. A draft card may only be dragged into /factory-refine: every column after it needs a written-out card to act on, so a draft anywhere else is a card that skipped its intake.
